response.evidence: The dataset has no applicant-level indication of the user's record, so the individual claim cannot be verified. Among Hispanic or Latino applicants, denials are not evidently higher than among other groups in this sample; the denial cases are spread across derived_race categories (White, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latino, Asian, Other). Hispanic or Latino male applicants appear in both originated and denied outcomes, with most of their loans originated. The data cannot establish causation: denial reasons (debt-to-income ratio, loan-to-value ratio, income, loan amount) are recorded in the same rows and were not controlled for in any statistical test. The sample is small and unbalanced, so the absence of a visible disparity here is not proof that no discrimination occurred, only that this dataset does not show evidence of it.
